headline: Infineon presents mixed RF and SystemC-AMS models for isolated gate-driver integration verification
fact: Guillermo Conde of Infineon presents SystemC-AMS/COSIDE models for smart gate drivers using coreless-transformer isolation. The flow combines discrete-event, timed-data-flow and electrical models with selectable RF baseband/passband abstractions. The integration example connects the RF isolation path to SPICE-level surrounding circuits for AMS verification. December 3 is the scheduled presentation date; November 27 on internal slide footers is not treated as the public presentation date. The slides describe a modeling approach, not company-wide deployment.

sources.title: Infineon: Bridging Power and RF
sources.summary: The public customer archive links COSEDA_UGM_2025__G.Conde_Infineon.pdf. The linked slides were reviewed: The cover names Conde and December 3; pages 12-15 show the isolated gate-driver architecture, mixed RF abstractions and SPICE integration.
